runtimeRestart.teamConfirmContent: Restart the agent process so it picks up external CLI config changes (such as a channel switch). Chat history is kept and the session resumes when possible.
runtimeRestart.confirmContent: Reconnect this conversation and interrupt any current reply. Safely recover stale Copilot locks and reload the original session. History is kept; failed requests are not resent. Copilot permissions return to manual confirmation.
runtimeRestart.initializingTooltip: The agent is initializing. Reconnect when it is ready
runtimeRestart.processingTooltip: Wait for the current reply to finish before reconnecting
